title: localswim launch credential
description: human.json or bot.json in the receipt's credential_directory, written by the provisioning block in docs/windows-operations.md. A reader MUST refuse a format or format_version it does not know. The schema cannot check duplicate or case-variant member names, role against the file name, or the decrypted plaintext.

role.description: The role the token belongs to. It MUST match the file name: human.json or bot.json.

token_dpapi_hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal of a Windows DPAPI blob made in user scope with no optional entropy, as ConvertFrom-SecureString writes it. The pattern pins DPAPI version 1, the provider GUID df9d8cd0-1501-11d1-8c7a-00c04fc297eb, and the flags at byte 40 to 0 (user scope). CryptUnprotectData returns the token in UTF-16LE: 43 unpadded base64url characters.
